steps.what: Teach students goal setting, independence and self-advocacy through supported practice

tasks.design: Retain direct personal-development teaching and feedback. Agreed goals in {DOCS} inform the lesson, with no automated replacement for supported practice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Self-advocacy and independence require contextual practice and feedback.
tasks.still_hard: Giving enough support while allowing the student's own choice and voice.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt teaching to the student's communication and confidence.

evidence.claim: Direct personal-development instruction remains fully counted in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is direct instruction and feedback, excluding formal program writing and separate lesson preparation.
Teacher and student establish practice needs during the fully retained step; no structured independence score is assumed.
No new configuration or recurring upkeep.
research_questions: Which supported practice lets the student express their own goal or preference?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; supported personal-development teaching remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Guide and counsel students about adjustments, academic problems and special academic interests

tasks.design: Keep student guidance as a direct conversation. Current school information in {DOCS} can support it, with no automated counselling or inferred student needs.
tasks.previous_blocker: The underlying problem may emerge only through conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing information supports the unchanged guidance.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding concerns and recognising when specialist support is needed.
tasks.human_edge: Listen, clarify and help a student choose a useful next step.

evidence.claim: Individual guidance and counselling remain fully counted personal work.

assumptions: Boundary is guidance about adjustment, problems or interests, excluding subject teaching and formal program documentation.
Student supplies concerns during the fully retained conversation; no complete structured student profile is assumed.
No system change or incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Student support arrangements and referral options
research_questions: Which concerns require a specialist rather than classroom-level guidance?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; listening and contextual guidance remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Observe students' performance, behavior, social development and physical health
Evaluate observed development and identify support or referral concerns within teaching scope

tasks.design: Retain direct observation and teacher interpretation, using existing {LMS} support information. No behavioural scoring, emotion inference or automated health assessment is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Development and apparent concerns require individual and situational context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing support information can inform the retained judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Separating an observed change from an unsupported diagnostic interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Notice meaningful changes and seek appropriate specialist advice.
tasks.altitude: Observation and evaluation duties remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: The design retains teacher observation and interpretation without an automated student evaluation.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher observation and developmental interpretation, excluding separate record transcription and clinical diagnosis.
Teacher produces observations directly in s1; no structured behaviour or health flag is assumed. Missing context requires discussion or referral in s2.
Existing pupil records remain unchanged; no new monitoring or incremental upkeep.
Observation concurrent with instruction must be allocated once across tasks rather than added twice.
unknowns: Observation practices and specialist referral procedures
research_questions: What direct evidence supports each concern and what lies outside teacher competence?

approvals.approved_version: Exact observations, contextual evidence and teacher assessment; new evidence requires renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; direct observation and interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Instruct through lectures, discussions and demonstrations in academic subjects

tasks.design: Retain direct academic instruction and responsive demonstrations. Materials in {LMS} support the lesson; preparation tools do not establish a saving in live teaching time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching needs adaptation to student understanding in the moment.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing teaching resources support the unchanged lesson.
tasks.still_hard: Making ideas accessible across varied learning and communication needs.
tasks.human_edge: Explain, demonstrate and respond to what students understand.

evidence.claim: Live instruction remains fully counted; lesson-preparation capability is not a teaching-time result.

assumptions: Boundary is live subject instruction, excluding preparation, formal assessment and separate records.
Teacher provides explanations and observes student responses within the fully retained lesson; no structured understanding signal is assumed.
No new configuration or recurring upkeep.
unknowns: Subject mix, learning needs and classroom support
research_questions: Which explanation or demonstration helps students participate in this lesson?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; live teaching and interaction remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Direct personal-development teaching, counselling, observation and subject instruction remain unchanged.
reach: Coordinate student support with assistants and specialist staff
role.ambitious_version: No expanded authority is attributed to these unchanged teaching tasks.
